name: paperforge
description: Render, check and publish research documents — reports, policy briefs, annexes and slide decks — from markdown. Bundles the build pipeline and the conventions that keep published documents self-contained, correctly paginated and free of internal machinery. It renders and gates; it does not write content and does not decide what a document should say.
author: RealTimeX

skills.name: paperforge
skills.description: Render, check and publish research documents from markdown: reports, briefs, annexes and presentations. Does not author them.
